name: Derived Survey Product
abstract: A processed output derived from a geometric survey dataset — section drawing, triangulated mesh, deviation map or registration report — modelled as a CRMdig D9 Data Object. Profiles ogc.heritage.digital-representation, adding a mandatory PROV derivation link to the parent survey dataset and a structured CRMdig D10 Software Execution sub-object recording the processing parameters.
